name: Hedgehog ligand autoprocessing and palmitoylation
rationale: All members concern self-cleavage and N-terminal/cysteine lipid modification of secreted proteins exemplified by Hh-Np processing, release and HHAT palmitoylation, distinguishing it from RAS C-terminal processing and PORCN-driven Wnt lipidation confusables.

name: PTEN-mediated restraint of PI3K-AKT signaling
rationale: Members cover PTEN stability, localization, ceRNA/lncRNA control and loss in cancer together with AKT/TORC2 output and negative regulation of PI3K-AKT, unlike confusables centred on nuclear inositol phosphate synthesis or PAK-2p34.

core: Renal regulation of blood pressure and fluid volume
name: Renin-angiotensin and vasopressin regulation of blood pressure and volume
rationale: Members span angiotensin generation and signaling, vasopressin/AVPR and aquaporin water reabsorption, renal sodium and urine-volume control and systemic pressure, distinguishing it from vascular-tone and cation-chloride/osmotic-stress confusables.

name: Fibrinolysis and plasminogen activation control
rationale: Members address fibrin clot dissolution, positive and negative control of plasminogen activation and fibrinolysis and fibrinogen levels, separating it from coagulation-cascade, VWF, contact-pathway and matrix-degradation confusables.

core: Cytosolic bacterial sensing by NOD1/2 and ALPK1
name: NOD-like bacterial sensing with TAK1-mediated JNK and p38 activation
rationale: Members cover peptidoglycan/muramyl dipeptide sensing via NOD1/2, ALPK1 and NLR signaling with K63 ubiquitination and TAK1-driven stress-kinase output, unlike TLR, IPAF inflammasome and generic JNK-regulation confusables.

qualifier: meiotic entry, oocyte maturation and testis somatic cells
name: Germline development, meiotic entry and oocyte maturation
rationale: Members concern primordial germ cell migration and proliferation, meiotic activation and G2/MI control in oocyte maturation, plus Sertoli/Leydig and seminiferous tubule development, rather than gonadotropin-driven follicle growth or sex determination in the confusables.

qualifier: SLC26 family transport of sulfate, oxalate, iodide and chloride
name: SLC26 anion exchange of sulfate, oxalate and iodide
rationale: All members describe SLC26 exchangers and their substrates or disease variants (SLC26A3, SLC26A4), distinguishing them from SLC12 cotransporter, bicarbonate, thyroid NIS and CFTR confusables.

name: RUNX-family regulation of signaling and differentiation gene transcription
rationale: All members are RUNX1/2/3 transcriptional programs targeting BCR, interleukin, WNT and estrogen-receptor signaling and myeloid/keratinocyte differentiation genes, unlike granulopoiesis, megakaryocyte-focused RUNX1, Hox and FLT3 confusables.

name: FLT3 mutants resistant to midostaurin, gilteritinib and quizartinib
rationale: All members are FLT3 mutant sets resistant to specific kinase inhibitors; the drug set (midostaurin, gilteritinib, quizartinib, plus pexidartinib, sunitinib) distinguishes it from confusables covering lestaurtinib, crenolanib, ponatinib or KIT/PDGFR resistance.

name: Purine salvage of guanine and hypoxanthine
rationale: Members all concern recycling of purine bases and ribonucleosides into IMP/GMP via HPRT1, in contrast to the confusables' purine catabolism and ADA/PNP degradation.

qualifier: cadherin processing, degradation and apoptotic cleavage
name: Cadherin processing, degradation and cleavage at cell junctions
rationale: Members address CDH1 trafficking and degradation, CDH11 interactions and apoptotic cleavage of adhesion proteins within cell junction adhesion, unlike confusables on apical junction maintenance, desmosomes, hemidesmosomes or adherens junction assembly.

qualifier: N-glycan trimming, oligosaccharide catabolism and mannose metabolism
name: N-glycan trimming, oligosaccharide catabolism and mannose metabolism
rationale: Members combine ER N-glycan processing (MOGS, MAN1B1, dolichyl-phosphate-glucose), lysosomal oligosaccharide and glycoside breakdown, and mannose/amino-sugar phosphorylation, distinguishing it from sialic acid and UDP-GlcNAc biosynthesis confusables.

name: Spinal cord dorsoventral patterning and interneuron specification
rationale: All members concern dorsal/ventral neural tube patterning and specification of spinal association and ventral interneurons, unlike floor plate/axial mesoderm, midbrain/glial and forebrain/retina confusables.

name: Deoxyribonucleotide biosynthesis and pyrimidine salvage
rationale: Members center on making deoxyribonucleotides (dTTP, dNMPs, purine dNTPs) and pyrimidine nucleoside salvage, whereas confusables emphasize nucleotide catabolism or de novo ribo-pyrimidine synthesis.

name: Translation termination, ribosome rescue and mRNA surveillance decay
rationale: Members cover translation termination, NMD, no-go and non-stop decay and ribosome quality control of nascent peptides, distinguishing it from degron-rule proteolysis, mRNA 3'-end processing, nuclear exosome and translation-initiation confusables.

qualifier: IL-2, IL-10 and IL-12 with T-cell activation
name: IL-2, IL-10 and IL-12 production and T-cell activation regulation
rationale: Members regulate IL-2, IL-10 and IL-12 production together with activated T-cell proliferation and Treg differentiation, unlike confusables on IL-6/TNF suppression, broad T-cell suppression or IL-10/IL-27 receptor signaling.

qualifier: FLT3 and PDGFR mutants driving STAT5
name: Oncogenic FLT3 and PDGFR kinase signaling to STAT5
rationale: Members are mutant/fusion FLT3, PDGFRA/B and FGFR1 signaling with CBL regulation, TPO signaling and STAT5 activation, distinguishing it from EPO/interleukin cytokine-receptor confusables and ALK/FGFR amplification-fusion confusables.

name: Trans-synaptic adhesion organizing synapse assembly and receptor clustering
rationale: Members cover neurexin-neuroligin, SALM, LAR-type PTP and LGI-ADAM adhesion, pre/postsynaptic assembly and AMPA/NMDA/GABA receptor clustering at excitatory and inhibitory synapses, unlike the confusables' dendritic spine and structural plasticity.

name: Lymphocyte homing to lymphoid organs and S1P receptor signaling
rationale: Members address lymphocyte and dendritic cell migration into lymphoid organs, lymph node development, marginal zone B cells and S1P receptor signaling, distinguishing it from gut-lymphoid integrin and CXCR4/chemokine-receptor confusables.

name: Nuclear exosome and translation-coupled RNA surveillance and decay
rationale: Members combine exosome-mediated 3'-5' decay and trimming of rRNA, snRNA, snoRNA, tRNA and CUTs with NMD, no-go, non-stop decay and RQC, unlike confusables on tRNA processing, splicing/export or 5'-3' decay and 3'-end processing.

qualifier: spindle orientation, centriole duplication and primary cilium control
name: Centrosome microtubule organization, spindle orientation and ciliogenesis control
rationale: Members concern microtubule nucleation and anchoring at centrosomes, mitotic spindle positioning, centriole duplication/cohesion and primary cilium assembly/disassembly, distinguishing it from ciliary transport/motility and cytokinesis/checkpoint confusables.

name: G2 phase progression and G2/M checkpoint
rationale: Members are G2-phase, G2/M checkpoint and Chk1/Chk2 inactivation of cyclin B:CDK1 plus proliferation modules, unlike confusables on stimulated T-cell division, mitotic entry kinases or E2F-driven G1/S.

qualifier: targeting, membrane insertion, folding and quality control
name: ER protein targeting, membrane insertion, folding and quality control
rationale: Members cover SRP and tail-anchored targeting and insertion, ER folding, retention, ERQC and retrotranslocation for ERAD, distinguishing it from unfolded protein response and COPII/COPI vesicle trafficking confusables.

name: Lipoxygenase synthesis of HETEs, hepoxilins and lipoxins
rationale: All members are lipoxygenase products of arachidonate (5-, 12-, 15-HETE, hepoxilins, lipoxins), unlike cytochrome P450 hydroxylase/epoxygenase, leukotriene catabolism and omega-3 SPM confusables.

qualifier: CFTR anion secretion and pH-sensitive cation channels
name: CFTR anion secretion and pH-sensitive cation channels
rationale: Members combine CFTR-dependent anion and water transport and pancreatic secretion with TRP and TALK channels and acidic pH responses, distinguishing it from sour-taste, apical protein sorting and secretion confusables.
